description: This PHP test class performs unit testing on the MyReviewAPI class related to the 'My Reviews' feature in the Performance API module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup and test case methods, such as testing the 'getAll' API endpoint and ensuring other API methods throw not-implemented exceptions.

classes.name: MyReviewsAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the MyReviewAPI endpoints related to user's performance reviews in the HR system.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all reviews through the API, using different test cases streamed from a YAML data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testGetAll' method from a YAML configuration.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the create method of MyReviewAPI throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for create are not implemented and throw exceptions.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that delete functionality throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for delete are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests that the getOne API method throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that validation rules for getOne are unimplemented.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that update method throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for update are not implemented.
